Advanced Architecture Powering Methstreams

Dynamic Bitrate Adjustment

Our integrated media player intelligently samples real-time download speeds, dynamically fine-tuning video resolution to prevent stream pauses and frame stuttering.

Edge Content Distribution

Stream packets are distributed across global edge caches positioned near your location, slashing round-trip latency and delivering instant player startup times.

GPU Hardware Decoding

Video decoding duties are automatically offloaded to your hardware GPU instead of overloading the CPU, ensuring smooth 60 FPS motion on desktop and mobile.

Viewing Optimization Checklist
